summary.interpretation: Both saved microphone captures contain reproducible frequency-specific components during all 14 commanded tone groups, including 17--27 kHz. They fall substantially below the 2-kHz response. This establishes recorded pickup under the stated analysis, not isolated acoustic output, flat frequency response, calibrated SPL, high-frequency fidelity or ultrasonic qualification.
summary.most_important_next_evidence: Steady separated tones and a speaker-disconnected/microphone-blocked control, with fixed geometry and serial-specific microphone correction, would distinguish acoustic fundamentals from feedthrough and qualify levels. No new playback or hardware operation was performed for this analysis.

setup.interface: Audient iD14 MKII (CoreAudio name: Audient iD14)
setup.speaker: Edifier wired powered speaker pair; exact model not reverified in this offline review
setup.input2_role: Simultaneous frequency-component comparator only; never an electrical timing reference or input-1 correction.

stimulus.kind: Locally reconstructed SONIC Sheep E14 block; exact original waveform/order unavailable
stimulus.ramp_shape: Raised cosine, a declared local choice
stimulus.random_generator: NumPy PCG64 seeded shuffle, seed 20261023; same balanced sequence in both captures

method.preblock_baseline: Nonoverlapping 6-ms windows from 0.125 to approximately 0.875 s before the first source pip. Matched-frequency RMS = sqrt(mean(abs(complex_peak)^2)/2).
method.inblock_control: Other-pip windows excluding current and +/-2 neighbouring target-frequency events or first-through-sixth harmonic relationships within 334 Hz. This reduces, but does not remove, leakage/distortion contamination.
method.neighbour_excluded_target_group: A second target estimate removes target events having +/-1 or +/-2 neighbours at the same frequency or with first-through-sixth harmonic relationships within 334 Hz. This includes excluding 10.5-kHz neighbours for the 20.9-kHz estimate because their second harmonic is 21 kHz. The primary all-target estimate still contains all 600 pips.
method.input2_comparator: Same-frequency, same-event-window projection of simultaneously recorded input 2. Its wiring/gain are not independently qualified. This is a feedthrough comparator, not an acoustic-isolation control, electrical timing reference or noise correction for input 1.
method.statistic_note: Contrasts above baseline/control are amplitude ratios in dB, not noise-subtracted calibrated SNR. All source frequencies have 600 pips with the same -24-dBFS peak.

calibration_search.what_was_found: Planning/source/verification JSON records describe the M50 chart and electronic calibration file but state that the delivered serial-specific file had not been inspected. No actual response-correction dataset was found by the targeted project search.

provenance.paper_reference_scope: Frequency-list and pip-duration provenance only; this local pickup check is not a published paper result.

tests.scope: Synthetic sine RMS normalization across frequency/phase; suppression of a missing distant fundamental and silent-group finite output; rejection of same-frequency and 10.5-to-21-kHz harmonic neighbours for 20.9-kHz target/control groups.

provenance.aggregate_convention: frequency_results captures copy the per-run fixed-38-ms estimates. Relative levels subtract the corresponding same-run 2-kHz median; compact table minimum contrasts take the minimum of preblock/inblock ratios across both captures and all-target/neighbour-excluded estimates.

limitations: Continuous 10-ms pips do not isolate steady tones. Window leakage, transducer filtering/ringing, adjacent pips and harmonics can contribute.
Fixed approximate 37--39-ms alignment is for level sensitivity checks. Periodic-carrier ambiguity prevents using it as a delay measurement.
No serial-specific microphone calibration or SPL/gain calibration was applied. Detection does not establish flatness, fidelity or acoustic high-frequency qualification.
No speaker-disconnected or microphone-blocked isolation control was recorded. Electrical feedthrough was not excluded.
The Hann-weighted 6-ms projection has a finite frequency response (first null approximately +/-333 Hz). Components from transients and nearby energy are not perfectly isolated.
The 37--39-ms offset range was chosen from nearby nonperiodic-probe timing observations; it does not independently measure the periodic SONIC carriers delay.
Two captures of the same fixed sequence demonstrate short-run repeatability only. Geometry, gain, hardware route and acoustic environment were not independently recalibrated.
dBFS values describe recorded digital fundamental estimates. Relative-to-2-kHz levels are uncorrected full-chain comparisons and must not be presented as speaker-only sensitivity or SPL.

The 24-kHz component has the smallest recorded contrast above the local floor/control. The 20.9-kHz component is substantially sensitive to alignment window, consistent with a transient/notch-sensitive estimate.
No animal readiness, auditory response, neural timing or behavioral performance is established.

Off-frequency controls and target-event robustness subsets exclude +/-2 same-frequency/near-harmonic neighbours (within334Hz through sixth harmonic). This specifically removes10.5-kHz neighbours when assessing20.9kHz. Retained subsets have159--454pips; the primary all-target summaries retain600. Longer ringing, higher-order distortion, microphone/electrical coupling and unobserved paths remain unresolved.
Input2 is a simultaneous channel comparator with unmatched/undocumented gain and wiring. Its lower level does not prove acoustic causality or establish a rejection ratio for input1 feedthrough.

publication.included_material: Sanitized aggregate frequency-level statistics, quality checks and provenance hashes only.

plot_data.percentile_interpretation: 5th/95th percentiles of within-frequency pip projection amplitudes, normalized by the same-run 2-kHz group median. These are descriptive scatter bars, not confidence intervals or calibrated uncertainty. The 2-kHz normalization uncertainty is not propagated.
plot_data.recommended_label: Relative recorded fundamental estimate (dB versus 2 kHz); uncorrected microphone/interface/speaker chain

simultaneous_input2_comparator.role: Same-frequency estimate from the simultaneously recorded second input, in exactly the same event windows. It was not used for timing or subtracted from microphone input 1.
simultaneous_input2_comparator.interpretation: Input 2 shows no substantial target-event excess over its own matched-frequency baseline. Input 1 exceeds this comparator strongly. Input gains, impedance and input-2 wiring are not independently qualified, so these cross-input ratios neither calibrate electrical leakage rejection nor prove the input-1 signal was acoustic.
